name: When should I consider a major home renovation versus minor updates?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a major home renovation versus minor updates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a major home renovation when your existing space no longer meets your needs in terms of functionality, layout, or structural integrity, or if you're looking to significantly increase your home's value. Minor updates are suitable for refreshing aesthetics, addressing small repairs, or making incremental improvements. A major renovation often involves changing floor plans, adding square footage, or updating entire systems like plumbing or electrical. Evaluate your long-term goals and budget to determine the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Opt for major renovation when functional or structural changes are needed; minor updates are for aesthetic refreshes or small repairs.
